t: This is Wilton Place, a street in Knightsbridge that runs north to south, between Knightsbridge itself and Wilton Crescent. It's a quiet stretch of the city, and a few notable residents have had a connection to it. Henry Wellesley, the third Earl Cowley, an English aristocrat, was born here. Cecil Horace Pilcher, a Royal Navy vice-admiral, lived here.
